description: Configuration and the executor host. The charter and the coder definitions are seeded and edited in the application; an hourly tick measures the host (coder binaries, node, git, the MCP endpoint, the pack repository) and a setup process provisions the MCP token into the vault, clones the pack repository, pauses or resumes the model.

places.p-steward-charter: The charter (goal, principles, scope, autonomy, budget, schedule, repository, coder); edited in the app
places.p-steward-coders: Headless agent definitions (seeded; chosen in the app)
places.p-steward-infra: Host measurements (coder binaries, node, git, MCP, repository, disk)
places.p-steward-setup-cmd: Setup commands (health, provision, clone, pause, resume)
places.p-steward-repo: The pack repository record (path, remote, head, installed version)
places.p-steward-journal: Journal: every lane writes what it did

transitions.label: Run a setup process
transitions.description: steward-infra: health measures the host and the MCP endpoint; provision stores the MCP token in the vault for charter.tokenLanes and clones the pack repository; pause and resume act on the whole model through the MCP.
